notes: CEO — Creative Engineering Operations v1.0.0. The music recording platform built for the artist who does it all: raw vocal recording, an audio-track playlist (drop your beat in), a full mixer, plugin chains locked to every verse and every track, all your VST2, VST3, AU and CLAP plugins, 44 built-in effects, AI mastering and stem separation. No beat making. No clutter. Red, black and gold — opens with the round CEO medallion and the bass drop. Mac: universal build for Intel and Apple Silicon, macOS 10.15 and up, M4A export through Core Audio.
